assignments.name: event_class
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const topic = String($('Validate & Normalize').item.json.ingest.topic || '').toLowerCase(); const payload = $('Validate & Normalize').item.json.ingest.payload || {}; const status = String(payload.status || '').toLowerCase(); if (topic.includes('order_transactions') || topic.includes('transaction')) { if (['failure','failed','error','declined'].includes(status)) return 'ADJUSTMENT'; return 'CONVERSION'; } if (topic.startsWith('orders/')) return 'CONVERSION'; if (topic.includes('checkout') || topic.includes('cart')) return 'RECOVERABLE'; return 'OTHER'; })() }}

assignments.name: opportunity_type
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const topic=String($('Validate & Normalize').item.json.ingest.topic || '').toLowerCase(); const payload=$('Validate & Normalize').item.json.ingest.payload || {}; if (topic === 'order_transactions/create' && ['failure','failed','error','declined'].includes(String(payload.status || '').toLowerCase()) && ['authorization','sale'].includes(String(payload.kind || '').toLowerCase())) return 'PAYMENT_FAILURE'; if (topic.includes('cart')) return 'ABANDONED_CART'; if (topic.includes('checkout')) return 'ABANDONED_CHECKOUT'; return ''; })() }}

assignments.name: template_reference
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const topic=String($('Validate & Normalize').item.json.ingest.topic || '').toLowerCase(); if (topic === 'order_transactions/create') return 'payment_failure'; if (topic.includes('cart')) return 'abandoned_cart'; if (topic.includes('checkout')) return 'abandoned_checkout'; return ''; })() }}

nodes.name: Resolve Shopify Tenant
nodes.notes: Resolve the tenant from the signed Shopify shop-domain identity; never trust a tenant UUID supplied by the webhook.

nodes.name: Bind Tenant Context
nodes.notes: Apply the authoritative shop-domain mapping or retain the explicit tenant for authenticated internal events.

nodes.name: Verify Shopify HMAC
nodes.notes: Fail closed unless the exact raw Shopify request body validates against the app secret stored in Supabase Vault as henvalt_shopify_app_secret.

nodes.name: Project Order From Event
nodes.notes: Project the Shopify order event into the tenant-scoped orders table idempotently.

nodes.name: Evaluate Order Attribution
nodes.notes: Evaluate tracking-token, checkout, and customer evidence; billing eligibility remains governed by attribution confidence.

nodes.name: Stop Recovery After Order
nodes.notes: Stop outstanding recovery interventions only for confirmed/probable order attribution.

nodes.name: Post Recovery To Ledger
nodes.notes: Post only economically attributable recovered revenue; the RPC is idempotent.

nodes.name: Deactivate Shopify Connection
nodes.notes: Deactivate only the Shopify connection that emitted app/uninstalled. Recovery preflight and delivery authorization also require the originating connection to remain active.
